Definition: properly, to bend, i.e. (by implication) to clasp; also (reflexively) to turn around or aside
BiblicalUsage: 1) to twist, grasp, turn, grasp with a twisting motion; 1a) (Qal) to grasp; 1b) (Niphal) to twist, weave, wind
